description: Source code for a tool converting minidump files to ELF core files, involving parsing minidump structures, handling thread and memory info, and writing ELF core dump format.

classes.name: CrashedProcess
classes.description: Holds parsed minidump info including threads, memory mappings, debug info, and signatures.

classes.name: CrashedProcess::Thread
classes.description: Represents a thread with register states, stack info, and thread ID.

classes.name: CrashedProcess::Mapping
classes.description: Represents a memory mapping with permissions, address range, filename, and data.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage info for the tool.

methods.name: writea
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor handling short writes and EINTR.

methods.name: sex
methods.description: Determines system endianness.

methods.name: ParseThreadRegisters
methods.description: Parses thread register states based on architecture.

methods.name: ParseThreadList
methods.description: Parses thread list from minidump and fills CrashedProcess threads.

methods.name: ParseSystemInfo
methods.description: Parses system info from minidump and verifies architecture and OS.

methods.name: ParseCPUInfo
methods.description: Parses CPU info section.

methods.name: ParseProcessStatus
methods.description: Parses process status section.

methods.name: ParseLSBRelease
methods.description: Parses LSB release info.

methods.name: ParseMaps
methods.description: Parses memory maps from minidump.

methods.name: ParseEnvironment
methods.description: Parses environment variables.

methods.name: ParseAuxVector
methods.description: Parses auxiliary vector or maps info.

methods.name: ParseCmdLine
methods.description: Parses command line arguments.

methods.name: ParseDSODebugInfo
methods.description: Parses DSO debug info and link map.

methods.name: ParseExceptionStream
methods.description: Parses exception info from minidump.

methods.name: WriteThread
methods.description: Writes thread info and register states to ELF core format.

methods.name: ParseModuleStream
methods.description: Parses module list and signatures.

methods.name: AddDataToMapping
methods.description: Adds data to existing memory mapping.

methods.name: AugmentMappings
methods.description: Augments memory mappings with thread stacks and link map.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function parsing minidump, constructing ELF core, and writing output.
